FFmpeg video component for NDIPlayer

FFmpeg https://ffmpeg.org/ - Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers.
This software uses FFmpeg as an independent command-line process under LGPLv3
or later. FFmpeg and its libraries remain replaceable in the video directory.
No changes were made to FFmpeg or its libraries. No GPL-only or nonfree build
was selected. No ownership of FFmpeg is claimed. LGPL rights, including reverse
engineering to debug changes to these libraries, are not restricted.

Version: n8.1.3-27-g8dca1586f4-20261031, Windows x64 LGPL shared.
Binary provider (linked by ffmpeg.org/download.html): FFmpeg-Builds/BtbN.
Archive SHA256: 5CEF7BC48E513F3CEE7C881E8B2999D835541EDB1846C3E89443A67F8F8556AB
Original archive:
https://github.com/FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/autobuild-2026-10-31-12-59/ffmpeg-n8.1.3-27-g8dca1586f4-win64-lgpl-shared-8.1.zip

Corresponding FFmpeg source, included as video/FFmpeg-source.zip:

Build scripts, included as video/FFmpeg-build-scripts.zip:
https://github.com/FFmpeg-Builds/FFmpeg-Builds/archive/5031c6f1082414e53688d39e521849905071070d.zip
Build command: ./makeimage.sh win64 lgpl-shared 8.1
               ./build.sh win64 lgpl-shared 8.1
Full configure line and compiler version: video/BUILD-CONFIGURATION.txt.
Build scripts contain recipes and upstream source references for dependencies.
License text: video/COPYING.LGPLv3 and video/COPYING.GPLv3.

The provider retains the last build of each month for two years. Keep the verified
original ZIP with your development files; pass it to prepare-video.ps1 -Archive.
Keep the matching source and build-script archives for offline preparation too.
The installer is self-contained and requires no Internet access to install.
